camel_example: aliyun aideepsign CreateWatermarkExtractTask --region cn-hangzhou --FileType video --version 2026-05-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits an invisible watermark extraction task to extract invisible watermarks from image, video, or audio files, and returns a task ID for asynchronous query of the extraction results
description_zh: 提交暗水印提取任务，从图片、视频或音频文件中提取暗水印，返回任务 ID 用于异步查询提取结果
name: CreateWatermarkExtractTask

parameters.help_en: The reserved idempotency field. This field is not supported. Passing this field does not cause an error, but it does not produce an idempotency effect
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等字段，暂不支持。传入不会报错，但当前不产生幂等效果
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The file type. Valid values: `image`, `video`, and `audio`. The value must be the same as the `FileType` used when the watermark was embedded
parameters.help_zh: 文件类型，取值：`image`（图片）、`video`（视频）、`audio`（音频）。必须与嵌入该水印时的 `FileType` 一致
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the file from which the watermark is to be extracted. Images, videos, and audio files are supported. Only HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. The maximum file size is 150 MB. The URL must be publicly accessible. Provide a presigned URL of an Alibaba Cloud OSS object in the same region as the site you are calling (Hangzhou site -> regions in the Chinese mainland, Singapore site -> ap-southeast-1)
parameters.help_zh: 待提取水印文件的 URL 地址，支持图片、视频和音频，仅支持 http/https 协议；大小上限 150 MB。须为公网可访问的 URL；推荐提供与所调用站点同地域的阿里云 OSS 预签名 URL（杭州站点→国内地域，新加坡站点→ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The reserved field. No valid values are available. Do not pass this field when you call the operation
parameters.help_zh: 预留字段，当前无有效取值，建议调用时不传
parameters.name: reserved

Code.description_en: The business error code. If the request is successful, OK is returned
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 OK

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. If the request is successful, `200` is returned
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. If the request is successful, "success" is returned
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 "success"

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the invisible watermark extraction task. You can use this ID to call GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult to query the result
TaskId.description_zh: 暗水印提取任务 ID，用于调用 GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult 查询结果
TaskId.title_en: 暗水印提取任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult查询
TaskId.title_zh: 暗水印提取任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult查询
